data.title: The phone parking spot
data.body: Open with a phone placed outside reach. Show a three-step, 25-second evening ritual. End with the journal, not a sleep outcome claim. CTA: save the routine.

data.title: The tiny bedroom reset

data.title: Shift-worker wind-down
data.body: Frame the routine around finishing a shift rather than a clock time. Creator describes personal preferences, without promising better sleep. CTA: share your wind-down cue.

data.title: Two-minute checklist
data.body: Use a split-screen checklist and real-time demonstration: phone away, tomorrow on paper, lights low. Keep offer and duration matched to control. CTA: save the checklist.

data.title: The phone parking spot
data.body: Audience: people exploring a repeatable evening routine. Direction: Open with a phone placed outside reach. Show a three-step, 25-second evening ritual. End with the journal, not a sleep outcome claim. CTA: save the routine. Deliverable: one original 20–35s vertical video and two hook cuts. Avoid copying V01-6, medical claims and guaranteed results. Label sponsorship in any future real deployment. Keep offer constant. Measure 72h saves/view and qualified clicks/view; examine orders descriptively. Rights, usage period and proposed $180 fee require a separate agreement. Draft due 2026-10-30; creative review 2026-10-31. Source: V01-6, 7× creator baseline.
